hooks.command: jq -n --arg msg 'A git push just completed. CLAUDE.md Documentation-Sync Directive applies — analyze the diff between the previous and current HEAD on the pushed branch (git log @{u}@{1}..HEAD if available, else compare against origin/main) and propose updates to README.md, the Specification Document (TECHNICAL_SCORING_DOCUMENTATION.md), and DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md in the directive required output format. Output: No updates required for any unchanged document.' '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $msg}}'
